payload.name: Extract Activity Domain Disclosures
payload.description: When a user explicitly states what they write about, study, research, or recommend, extract a preference or state memory for that activity domain during candidate extraction.
content: During extraction, treat explicit first-person statements of ongoing activities (writing about, studying, researching, recommending, focusing on) as candidate memories, even if phrased conversationally in a list.
Emit one memory using preference or state that records the activity and its subjects; do not require a follow-up question before extracting.
If an existing candidate or memory already covers the same fact, skip; otherwise always generate the candidate so the fact is preserved.

solves: The extraction stage occasionally emits zero candidates from a message where the user explicitly states an ongoing activity domain (e.g., what they write about, study, or recommend), causing later questions about that domain to be unanswerable. This skill applies when a future message contains an explicit first-person statement of such an activity; it should then generate a preference/state memory capturing the activity and subjects. It must not apply to messages that only mention a subject with no stated activity or personal involvement.
